To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@vectrahealth.com>, Eric Morales <eric.morales@vectrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Contract Playbook & Close Cadence for Vectra POC

Hi Priya / Eric —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. As promised, I want to align on the contracting path so we have a clean close by the end of August for the pilot (POC).

Proposed next steps (MAP-style, short):
- Week 1 (this week): introductions to legal/terms owner + share redline template
- Week 2: Vectra sends any key non-starter terms or comments
- Week 3: Redwood legal returns a redline + we prepare execution doc
- Week 4: Sign & kickoff (target: Aug 24)

Can you confirm who on your side owns terms/contracting and whether that timeline is realistic? I attached a short contract-playbook-template and an initial MAP XLS with milestones to help.

Attachments: contract-playbook-template.docx (stub), initial-map-vectra.xlsx (stub)

If you prefer a quick 20-min sync to introduce stakeholders, I can set it up for tomorrow afternoon.

Thanks,
Connor

Connor —

Thanks for the clear plan. Timeline looks reasonable from a procurement perspective. Quick notes:
- Procurement will own PO/ordering (Eric). Contract and redlines go to Legal (Danielle Wu).
- Legal bandwidth: Danielle is available for a review starting Jul 26; she prefers to receive your proposed SOW and any non-standard clauses up front.
- We typically need a 5-business-day internal review once Legal gets the draft.

Looping Danielle on this thread so she has context. Danielle — can you confirm you received the attached contract template and whether any of the clauses look like immediate blockers?

Priya Singh

Subject: Re: Fwd: Contract Playbook & Close Cadence for Vectra POC — legal intro and redline ask

Connor / team —

Thanks for the heads up and for including the playbook. I'll lead Redwood's redline and coordinate with Rishi on any commercial exceptions. Initial thoughts after a quick scan:
- Liability cap in the template is higher than our standard; I'll propose a mutual cap tied to fees for the POC.
- Data residency clause: confirm Vectra's preference (US-only or multi-region). If US-only, we'll note that as a requirement but try to keep the clause focused on storage.
- Security attestation: Priya, do you need SOC 2 evidence in the contract or is referencing the report in the SOW sufficient?

I'll prepare a first-pass redline and comments by Aug 2 if I receive Danielle's redline and any non-standard asks by Jul 26. If Danielle can share edits directly to the doc or via DocuSign linkage that's fine — otherwise I'll upload our redline to the HubSpot deal and ping the thread.

Attachments: none

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0084
